title: In memoriam: Dr. Julia Brosnan
summary: The Knowledge Portal team joins the worldwide diabetes research community in mourning the passing of Dr. Julia Brosnan.
bodyHtml:
The Knowledge Portal team joins the worldwide diabetes research community in mourning the passing of Dr. Julia Brosnan on March 24th, 2021. Julia was one of the founding members of the AMP T2D consortium and was a fervent proponent of open data sharing. She was a strong supporter of the Knowledge Portal effort and a personal friend to many members of the Portal team. We will always remember her for her warmth, kindness, and energy.

Dr. Brosnan's full obituary and information on memorial services are found here.
